history.summary: Freehold D15 3BR (1,528sqft) at $2.0M / $1,309psf, 470m to Kembangan MRT — looks cheap, but Radix is a 21-unit boutique with only 4 URA transactions and 3.2% yield. The headline MMR 807 is an artifact of thin data; illiquidity is the real story.
history.rating_rationale: On paper attractive: freehold, large 1,528sqft, $1,309psf well under the (thin) $1,445 median, 470m to Kembangan EW6, desirable D15. But the development has just 21 units total and only 4 URA transactions — the 7.49%/yr CAGR and MMR 807 / score 807 are statistically meaningless and must be heavily discounted (anti-anchoring). A 21-unit block means shallow exit liquidity: any single forced seller moves the market, and price discovery is poor. Reviews note exclusivity/privacy as a plus but that is an own-stay virtue, not an investment one. Freehold + large size + location give real downside support, so not an Avoid — but thin liquidity and unreliable appreciation data cap it firmly at Neutral.

history.summary: A freehold 3BR in D15 asking $1,309 psf that screens cheap vs recent project comps (~$1,386-$1,505 psf), but the signal rests on near-zero comparable depth and the project is a tiny, illiquid 19-year-old boutique.
history.rating_rationale: The $2.0M / 1,528 sqft asking ($1,309 psf) does sit below recent Radix transactions (2024 deals ~$1,386-$1,505 psf), and a comparable 1,528 sqft listing is marketed at $2.08M-$2.10M, so the unit is genuinely at the low end of its own project. But the algo's headline cheapness (-32.7% age-adj, score 766) is built on essentially no support: psf_cohort_txns=0 and appreciation_txns=4. Per v3.4 priors, a large negative premium on near-zero comparables is a data quirk, not a verified bargain, and trailing 7.49% CAGR carries no forward weight. Radix is only 21 units and built 2007, so resale liquidity is thin and the freehold tenure is not itself a forward edge. D15 (RCR) forward realized ~+3.5% is decent but not exceptional. Real-ish cheapness, but thin data and weak liquidity cap this at Neutral.
